subject: Ava Solutions - hosted per-token concession / approval path
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Ava Solutions - hosted per-token concession / approval path

Team —

Quick summary: Ava Solutions (contact: Elena Morales) asked for a sizable concession on our hosted per-token rates. They’re running a pilot now and are forecasting ~500M tokens/month in steady-state, with a proposed 12-month committed spend. Procurement wants a straightforward per-token discount (they asked for 30% off list) and a clause in the SOW about minimum monthly usage. They need pricing confirmation this week to include in their board materials.

I attached the pricing workbook they shared and a draft SOW (pricing_workbook.xlsx; Ava_Solutions_SOW_draft.pdf). Key asks:
- Per-token rate below our published rate for their committed tier (they proposed 30% off list)
- 12-month commitment with monthly minimums
- A clause to allow short-term burst credits if they exceed committed levels in early months

Request: what’s the approval path here and what concession do we feel comfortable proposing? If this needs pricing committee approval, please list next steps and whom I should loop in.

Thanks — I want to respond to Elena with a proposal by EOD Wed (Jan 13).

— Dylan
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ava Solutions - hosted per-token concession / approval path

Thanks for the summary, Dylan. I spoke to Elena on Friday — they’re in procurement crunch and want a single-line per-token discount rather than a complicated tiered effective price. A few data points:
- Pilot usage currently ~60M tokens/month but they expect to ramp to ~500M within 6 months if product-market fit holds.
- Primary requirement is predictability for their CFO; legal will accept a usage-based SOW with minimums.
- They asked for the discount to apply retroactively to the start of the paid pilot.

My recommendation (practical and conservative): propose a structured concession we can operationalize without opening the rate card broadly:
- Offer a temporary introductory discount: 20% off list rate for months 1–3 (to ease pilot conversion)
- Move to a committed tier price equivalent to 15% off list for months 4–12, contingent on a 12-month commitment and a 400M tokens/month floor averaged quarterly
- No retroactive application beyond the pilot invoice month; billing credits only if monthly usage falls below floor and we agreed in advance

This preserves some upside, limits exposure, and is easier to approve. I’ll attach a simple redline to the SOW if we decide to move forward. If we want to be more aggressive (closer to their 30%), we should have a larger upfront commit or a multi-year deal.

— Marissa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ava Solutions - hosted per-token concession / approval path

Appreciate the framing. A few internal guardrails from my side:
- We should avoid setting a precedent of blanket 30% off list for hosted per-token pricing unless there is a commensurate committed spend or strategic value (e.g., marquee logo / joint marketing).
- Approvals: discounts >20% for hosted per-token must be signed off by pricing committee (pricing@redwood.ai) and finance. Anything <=20% can be signed by me for deals under $250k ARR equivalent.
- For this request, we need a clear commit schedule and a simple clawback if minimums aren’t met. Also require that legal approves the minimums and usage measurement clause.

Please capture the recommended contract language and the expected ARR / monthly run-rate in the attached HubSpot record: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/contacts/AVSO-12345 — I’ll flag this for pricing committee review if Marissa wants to push above 20%.

If Marissa wants to proceed with the 20%/15% structure, I’m comfortable signing off provided finance confirms the modeled ARR and the SOW has the required minimums / measurement.

— Sean
VP, Sales Operations
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@avasolutions.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@avasolutions.com
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 07:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ava Solutions - hosted per-token concession / approval path

Hi Dylan and Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Carol (CFO) needs a concrete proposal for next Tuesday (Jan 19). A few clarifications from our side:
- We can commit to 12 months and aim for an average of 450–500M tokens/month, but the first two months are guaranteed lower (pilot conversion).
- We would prefer the discount to be applied to charges from the paid pilot start date, not retroactively across the entire pilot period.
- We’re open to a conditional clause where missing the quarterly floor triggers a partial credit rather than a full clawback.

If you can send a short term-sheet with the proposed monthly floor, the blended per-token prices for months 1–3 and 4–12, and the SOW redline language for minimums/measurement, we can take to procurement and the CFO.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Platform Partnerships
Ava Solutions
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ava Solutions - hosted per-token concession / approval path

Thanks for circling everyone in. I reviewed the workbook and the projected ARR. My decision: approve a constrained concession with the following conditions — these are approval-level items to share back with Ava and to include in the SOW.

Approved structure (conditions):
- Intro period: 20% off list for months 1–3 (pilot conversion support)
- Committed tier: 15% off list for months 4–12, contingent on a 12-month SOW and an averaged quarterly floor of 400M tokens/month
- If quarterly usage falls below the floor, we will issue a pro-rated billing credit equal to the difference between actual spend and committed spend up to a maximum of 25% of the discounted value for that quarter (this caps our downside)
- No retroactive discount beyond the invoice month; retro-credit only by pre-approved exception
- Clause: minimums and measurement methodology to be defined in SOW; finance needs visibility into token measurement and ingestion events

If you (Marissa/Dylan) confirm acceptance, I’ll issue a formal approval note that you can attach to the HubSpot record and I’ll notify pricing@redwood.ai and finance to prepare the billing terms. If Ava pushes for >20% persistent discount, route to the pricing committee.

— Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
